title: Gigant kalmarning ko'zi 27 santimetrgacha yetadi

scenes.text: Gigant kalmarning ko'zi 27 santimetrgacha yetadi, bu basketbol to'pidan ham katta.
Bu hayvonlar olamida ma'lum bo'lgan eng katta ko'zlardan biri.
Kalmar okeanning quyosh nuri deyarli yetib bormaydigan qorong'i qatlamlarida yashaydi.
scenes.keywords: dark deep sea water faint light particles

scenes.text: Olimlarning fikricha, bunday ko'z unga yaqinlashib kelayotgan kashalotni uzoqdan payqashga yordam beradi.
Kashalot esa gigant kalmarning asosiy yirtqichlaridan biri hisoblanadi.
scenes.keywords: sperm whale diving into deep blue ocean

description:
Gigant kalmarning ko'zi 27 santimetrgacha yetadi va bu hayvonlar olamidagi eng katta ko'zlardan biri. Olimlar bunday katta ko'z qorong'i chuqurlikda yaqinlashayotgan kashalotni uzoqdan sezishga yordam beradi, deb hisoblaydi.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-09: TRUE (one softening edit: 'eng xavfli dushmani' changed to 'asosiy yirtqichlaridan biri'). Nilsson, Warrant, Johnsen, Hanlon, Shashar, 'A unique advantage for giant eyes in giant squid', Current Biology 22(8), 683-688 (2012): photographed giant squid eye about 27 cm across, 9 cm pupil; hypothesis that the eye evolved to spot approaching sperm whales (a whale stirs bioluminescent plankton), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cub.2012.02.031 ; ScienceDaily summary, https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2012/03/120315123024.htm ; National Geographic, https://www.nationalgeographic.com/animals/article/120315-giant-squid-eyes-basketball-whales-nilsson-science (colossal squid eye is about the same size, so the script says 'one of the largest', not 'the largest'; the whale-spotting use is a hypothesis, hence 'olimlarning fikricha')
